channel.title: PAGASA NLPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NLPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 FINAL #NLPRSD
Issued at 04:15 AM 13 November 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NLPRSD
Issued at 04:42 PM 12 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #IlocosSur(Alilem, Tagudin), #LaUnion(Bangar, Luna, Balaoan, Santol), #Benguet(Bakun and Kibungan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #IlocosSur(Sugpon) and #LaUnion(Sudipen) which may persist within 30 mins to 1 hour and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 31 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 31 FINAL #NLPRSD
Weather System: Northeast Monsoon (Amihan)
Issued at 02:00 PM 12 November 2026

All Rainfall Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 30 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 30 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Northeast Monsoon (Amihan)
Issued at 08:00 AM 12 November 2026

Light to Moderate rains are expected over #Aurora(Dipaculao, Baler, Dingalan, SanLuis and MariaAurora) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM Today.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
